title: Operational Location v1 (Draft)
description: Draft durable Operational Location identity. It owns only approved name, aliases, lifecycle, stable identity and primary Location Type history; specialist domain data remains separate.

operationalLocationId.description: Stable identity retained through rename, Type change, decommissioning, reactivation and merge.

accountableInternalOwnerReference.description: Stable reference to the accountable internal role assignment. It must not be a hardcoded named-person governance rule.

lifecycleState.description: Minimal current lifecycle state compiled from accepted Pack 1 behaviour; broader lifecycle catalogues remain unresolved.

mergedIntoOperationalLocationId.description: Permanent reference to the surviving Operational Location when this record is merged.

aliases.description: Historical or alternative names retained without replacing the current approved name.

locationTypeHistory.description: All effective-dated primary Location Type assignments, including the current open assignment.
